title: Plan-wide: distribution, licenses, styling
intro: Round 1: public repo for now, monorepo packages/ui + apps/catalog, package+P1 first then catalog, all 93 entries + 22 enhancements in milestones, rest of SPEC kept. React Bits LICENSE (checked 2026-10-26): use allowed inside an application/website, but 'you may not ... redistribute the components themselves, whether alone, in a bundle, or as a ported version'. A public repo or public package containing them is redistribution; the public catalog website is allowed.

options.label: GitHub Packages @dav033/david-ui, published by GitHub Actions; installing needs a read:packages token in .npmrc (and as a Vercel env var in consuming projects); visibility follows the repo
Public npm (no token, but React Bits can never enter the package)

questions.why: Real semver installs, and if the repo later becomes private the package follows it without changing registry or consumers.

options.label: Public now; before the React Bits milestone the repo and the package become private (the Vercel catalog stays public)
Repo stays public; all 32 React Bits entries are reimplemented clean-room (no copied code)
Repo stays public; React Bits entries are dropped from the package

questions.why: React Bits is the last milestone, so you keep the public repo for most of the work; clean-room for 32 effects (WebGL backgrounds included) is a lot of extra work.

questions.text: How do consuming projects get the styles?

options.label: Consumers use Tailwind 4: the package exports theme.css (tokens as @theme, Catppuccin default) and an @source for its compiled files
The package ships precompiled CSS; consumers need no Tailwind

questions.why: maros, pictures, dav033-demos, proposal-studio, lotm and trainingapp all use Tailwind 4 + React 19; one Tailwind build avoids duplicated utilities and lets each project override tokens.

questions.text: Agent integration (was the token-protected registry index)?
questions.suggested: The package ships AGENTS.md + llms.txt (components, props, install and theming guide), and the public catalog serves the same index at /llms.txt and /index.json.
questions.why: Agents discover components without auth; the index is generated from the same manifest as the catalog.
